paragraphs: Here's what I want you to hold onto, friend: the LORD keeps His promises, down to the last detail. Joshua 21:45 says, "Not one of all the LORD's good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled." Not one. Not most of them, not the big ones, ALL of them. The land, the rest, the cities for the Levites, every bit of it. That's the kind of God who sent an angel into a junk drawer for a worn-out stamper.

And look at how this chapter shows it. The Levites got no land of their own, and the LORD still made sure they were given cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock, forty-eight cities in all (Joshua 21:2, 41). Nobody got skipped, and nobody got a little extra. When the LORD's people follow His command, everybody gets looked after. If you ever feel like your share got lost in the shuffle, this chapter says He keeps count.

So here's what it means for you today. Joshua 21:43 says the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and verse 44 says He gave them rest on every side. The promise was made long before they ever stood in that land, and He kept it anyway. So when you're waiting on something God said, keep your oven warm. He has never dropped a promise, and He's not about to start with you.
